description: This Scala source file defines an internal parser class `RqlOptionParser` for parsing RQL options such as sort, limit, cursor, and size according to a specified grammar. It includes methods to parse options from input strings into corresponding objects used within the Ditto project, utilizing the parboiled2 parsing library. The file also provides a companion object implementing an OptionParser interface for external usage.

classes.name: RqlOptionParser
classes.description: A parser class extending RqlParserBase that parses RQL options such as sort and limit from input strings into domain-specific objects.

methods.description: Parses an input string containing RQL options into a list of Option objects.
